title: The Skysworn Remembrance Discipline
summary: The school discipline of the cultivation-side order on a vigilant memory that no detail escapes and that the whole company can draw on.

title: Manual of the Sapphire Recollection
summary: The school manual of a cobalt recollection kept in a clear unbroken line that can be cut into a foe's mind and sealed there.

title: The Zenith Memory Discipline
summary: The school's high discipline of a memory raised to the apex of the Core so that the past falls on the field in one sweep.

title: The Gale Remembrance Discipline
summary: The school discipline of a memory that stays lee of every wind of confusion and shelters a company from it.

title: Manual of the Storm-Kept Memory
summary: The school manual of a memory kept through storms and cast back into the minds of the foe as a storm of false and true alike.

title: The Covenant Memory Discipline
summary: The school's deepest discipline of a memory bound by covenant that erases a covenant-breaker's claim to it and strengthens all who keep it.
